title: Points and Distances
description:
```
Point A: (1, 2)
Point B: (4, 6)
Distance: 5
Midpoint: (2.5, 4)
Slope: 1.33333
Point C (5, 8) is on the line AB? no
Which quadrant is A? 1
```
hints: A function can return a whole struct: `return Point{ (a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2 };`.
For a vertical line `b.x == a.x`, so the slope would divide by zero. Check for that first and print "vertical" instead of calling `slope`.
requirements: Handle vertical line slope (division by zero) gracefully
